meta.title: Validate BST: the range narrows on the way down
meta.subtitle: Every node receives an open range (lo, hi) set by all of its ancestors. Node 9 passes when compared only with its parent 12, but it sits in the right branch of the root 10, so it must be greater than 10.

cards.title: Compare with the parent only: wrong
items: 9 < 12, so the parent check lets it through
9 is in the right branch of 10 and should be greater than 10
300 trees with one node changed at random: this check accepts 66 of the 238 broken ones

cards.title: Carry the range down: right
items: go left: the upper bound drops to the node's value
go right: the lower bound rises to the node's value
each node is compared once with (lo, hi): O(n) time, O(h) memory
